quest.summary: My hearth went cold the year the bells began. Does a fire kept by hand hold through one whole night?

offer: This hearth by my door is mine to keep. Yours is out there, where you choose.
Past the last house, build it before dusk. Feed it until dawn.
waiting: Out past the last house, a fire of your own. Light it before dusk.
Wood through the night, until the sky goes grey. A fire gone out takes it.
done: A fire of your own, a whole night. What is looked after is not forgotten.
Take this. Herbs and cord, the way we bound a hurt once.
